Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ 506beda020bbe576294122dccc7b483bf8167019

Verdict CLEAN. No code findings. Validation is limited by the sandbox graphics adapter.

- Local merge of current upstream/main (d2350d6a) was already up to date.
- All five new naming pins passed, including after mutation restoration.
- Library tests: 778 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored. The failure is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1792`: Metal found no graphics adapter in the sandbox.
- Quick gate: RED from that same adapter failure. The four integration suites passed.
- Clippy for camcraft-ui, all targets with warnings denied: GREEN.
- Mutations: removed one naming attachment at a time from machine_page.rs, machines_pane.rs, machine_editor.rs, machine_edm.rs, and machine_edm_editor.rs. Each matching pin went RED on an unnamed-input assertion. All restored pins went GREEN. Working tree is clean.
- Extra safety case: inch-mode numeric edits could corrupt machine dimensions or feeds. Existing inch drag/typed-entry and unit-switch/undo tests passed. The new numeric wrappers retain the same conversion and writeback helper.
- Rule checks: changed source files are under 400 lines. No new production unwrap/expect/panic. No golden, PNG, PROCESS_VERSION, dependency, .github, or scripts changes. Changelog: is present. Fixes # is absent; Refs #1119 is intentional and required by the linked issue for this partial slice.
